title: Reporters are Trash

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: What's up? If you're looking for tickets to the Hover Derby match, you can get them at the tunnel kiosk. Grab a Roxi Fynx jersey while you're there and I'll sign it for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's up? If you're looking for tickets to the Hover Derby match, you can get them at the tunnel kiosk. Grab a Roxi Fynx jersey while you're there and I'll sign it for you.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: The Battlefield Bits and the Neural Hornets. Whoever wins plays the Kettle Chaos Club tomorrow. That's the team I roll for. Course, there will be a couple of people rolling tomorrow... rolling to the med bus when I get done with 'em.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Battlefield Bits and the Neural Hornets. Whoever wins plays the Kettle Chaos Club tomorrow. That's the team I roll for. Course, there will be a couple of people rolling tomorrow... rolling to the med bus when I get done with 'em.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You from one of those gossip Feeds? Trying to get some sensational story bit so you can peddle adverts? Here, let me suggest one: "subtle reporter gets unsubtly punched in the throat."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You from one of those gossip Feeds? Trying to get some sensational story bit so you can peddle adverts? Here, let me suggest one: "subtle reporter gets unsubtly punched in the throat."

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: If I didn't have a match tomorrow, I would. Why don't you come down to the Marrow and square up with me before the game? Would love to get the blood flowing beforehand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I didn't have a match tomorrow, I would. Why don't you come down to the Marrow and square up with me before the game? Would love to get the blood flowing beforehand.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Don't judge me. You would be too if you had reporters and Loudcasters chasing you down to make money off the shit you say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't judge me. You would be too if you had reporters and Loudcasters chasing you down to make money off the shit you say.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Whatever. If you must know, I started playing after I got canned from the InfoLex call center. Access cut without so much as a courtesy call!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. If you must know, I started playing after I got canned from the InfoLex call center. Access cut without so much as a courtesy call!

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Well, let me emphasize the fact that I had some absolutely all-consuming anger. Turns out hover derby is a good outlet for blood boiling rage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, let me emphasize the fact that I had some absolutely all-consuming anger. Turns out hover derby is a good outlet for blood boiling rage.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You think I don't know that? You think I don't burn inside when I look at the logo? Thing is, you can't eat hate. Think that makes me a sellout?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I don't know that? You think I don't burn inside when I look at the logo? Thing is, you can't eat hate. Think that makes me a sellout?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Seriously? You're actually being serious right now? I have debt to pay and you're going to stand here and look down on me for it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? You're actually being serious right now? I have debt to pay and you're going to stand here and look down on me for it?

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Didn't mean to what? Degrade what I chose to do for work? How I make a living? If that's your thing then you and Deeala would be best friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't mean to what? Degrade what I chose to do for work? How I make a living? If that's your thing then you and Deeala would be best friends.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: You're right, I did. You should come to the match tomorrow night. We can finish talking then. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right, I did. You should come to the match tomorrow night. We can finish talking then. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Yeah, get to running. If you find the guts to strap on a pair of hover clamps, meet me in the tunnels. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, get to running. If you find the guts to strap on a pair of hover clamps, meet me in the tunnels. Blood stains aren't easy to wash out, so dress accordingly.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Same game different pieces. Look, I'm sorry I snapped at you. First the LUZ, then the Comms being down... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: No shit. Catch a break from the garbage and come to the match tomorrow. You'll probably enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Hover Derby. Fast-paced-ultimate-capture-the-frisbee-full-contact-glory. Best sport around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hover Derby. Fast-paced-ultimate-capture-the-frisbee-full-contact-glory. Best sport around.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: There's a story behind these tattoos. Not so much battle scars but victory markings. One of a kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a story behind these tattoos. Not so much battle scars but victory markings. One of a kind.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Let's just say the crimson color is unique. You won't find it ever again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's just say the crimson color is unique. You won't find it ever again.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Sure. It's listed in the Holocropolis along with a date of birth and a date of death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. It's listed in the Holocropolis along with a date of birth and a date of death.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Like I said: Hover Derby is the best sport around. If you're strong enough to compete in it. I gotta run, but you should come to the match tomorrow night. Going to be a good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I said: Hover Derby is the best sport around. If you're strong enough to compete in it. I gotta run, but you should come to the match tomorrow night. Going to be a good one.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Yeah, gotta play the hands we're dealt, right? Look, I gotta run. You should grab tickets for the match tomorrow night. It's a fun time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, gotta play the hands we're dealt, right? Look, I gotta run. You should grab tickets for the match tomorrow night. It's a fun time.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: I'll tell you one thing, people like you make me want to say "to the sea!" with all of it, and go join the Crusty Punks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you one thing, people like you make me want to say "to the sea!" with all of it, and go join the Crusty Punks.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Course, can't really call when the Comms don't work. Hell with 'em anyway. They can drink waste water for all I care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Course, can't really call when the Comms don't work. Hell with 'em anyway. They can drink waste water for all I care.

nodes.speaker: Roxi Fynx
nodes.text: Yeah, I play for my corporate captors whatever. What do you do that's so much better?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I play for my corporate captors whatever. What do you do that's so much better?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who's playing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who's playing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wouldn't even know what I'm watching.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wouldn't even know what I'm watching.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wouldn't even know what I'm watching.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wouldn't even know what I'm watching.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Brutal sport. How'd you start playing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Brutal sport. How'd you start playing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Brutal sport. How'd you start playing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Brutal sport. How'd you start playing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you have hashtag tattoos?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you have hashtag tattoos?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do you have hashtag tattoos?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do you have hashtag tattoos?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not a reporter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not a reporter.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's excessively violent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's excessively violent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Take a swing. See how that ends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take a swing. See how that ends.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Take a swing. See how that ends.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Take a swing. See how that ends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I swear I don't work for a Feed. Was just curious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I swear I don't work for a Feed. Was just curious.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I swear I don't work for a Feed. Was just curious.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I swear I don't work for a Feed. Was just curious.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sucks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sucks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But don't corps sponsor the teams?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But don't corps sponsor the teams?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But don't corps sponsor the teams?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But don't corps sponsor the teams?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kinda.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kinda.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think it makes you opportunistic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it makes you opportunistic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think it makes you opportunistic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think it makes you opportunistic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Woah, hold on! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah, hold on! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Woah, hold on! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Woah, hold on! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to—

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You asked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You asked.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right now? Leaving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right now? Leaving.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I work at a restaurant. Noodles and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's some weird stuff going on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Does it have a name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Does it have a name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What the?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What the?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gnarly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gnarly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's... someone's blood?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... someone's blood?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sheesh ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sheesh ...
